approach: Revision of round 1, answering the three findings. (F1) The critic is right: `Candidate.producer_report` (crates/athena-data/src/records.rs:863) already stores the final redacted report, `criteria_check` included. It is set in `build_candidate` (run/candidate.rs:73-84) and read by `pre_verdict_block` (introspect.rs:1024-1056, called from `failure_details` at 1109 and `event_of_job` at 1605-1611). It was added by commit 81b1374e of 2026-11-15 (HISTORY.txt:53). All 43 listed introspections are dated before it (the latest is 20261103). So the stored-event gap is already closed, and the only cause left is the brief: the producer is shown criteria and not how each is verified, and `unmet_criteria` trusts any entry with status met (send_back.rs:27-30). The plan names that single root cause. The per-attempt copy in the invocation `detail` is shipped because the accepted reading lists it as criterion 4, but it is described as a self-contained copy of the candidate's report, not new information. Changes: (1) crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs: a new section "How the verifier checks each criterion" in `producer_brief_with_evidence`, between `checkable_evidence_section` (line 743) and `criteria_check_section` (line 744). It has one line per criterion, keyed by its number, built by a pure `verifier_check_hint(text, kind)`. A criterion that only Athena's recorded checks can show gets the `left to Athena's checks` hint, from `is_athena_check_criterion`. Other Content criteria get a named file or diff line. Other Behavior criteria get a command that ran. A sweep criterion adds a repo-wide search with zero remaining hits. A rewrapped-prose criterion adds a line-width check. (F2) `is_athena_check_criterion` moves from send_back.rs:64-89 into briefs.rs beside `LEFT_TO_ATHENA` (line 843) as a `pub fn`, and send_back.rs imports it. athena-core already depends on athena-context. This gives the brief one classifier, and the hint can no longer contradict the criteria_check section (briefs.rs:857-861) for fmt, clippy and full-suite criteria. (F3) The matchers compare whole words and phrases after lowercasing and turning punctuation and hyphens into spaces, so 'wrapper' gets no width hint. (2) crates/athena-core/src/run/producer.rs: at the all-clear exit (`break Some(report)`, line 555), set the attempt's invocation `detail` to `self-check passed; redacted report: <json>`, the shape the failing path writes at lines 616-630. (3) D191 in docs/decisions.md and a CHANGELOG.md entry name the root cause (the brief gap) and cite candidate.producer_report and 81b1374e. producer.md and budgets.rs stay unedited: the information is in the brief, which is outside the budgeted sets (system facts, 'Prompt sets and budgets'), and any byte change to producer.md would move the `budget producer: 1043 of 1200` line in docs/system-facts.md, which is not a deliverable. No refusal or hold rule is added, so no refused-reading share applies.

decisions.choice: Name the brief gap as the one root cause. Present the passing-attempt `detail` as a per-attempt copy of the candidate's report, not as new information.
decisions.reason: Finding 1 holds. Read: `Candidate.producer_report` (records.rs:863) holds the redacted report with `criteria_check` (records.rs:821). `build_candidate` sets it (candidate.rs:83). `candidate_stage` keeps it even for an empty change (candidate.rs:172-180). `pre_verdict_block` (introspect.rs:1024-1056) puts the producer's status and evidence for each unmet criterion into the introspection event (introspect.rs:1605-1611), and its tests are at introspect.rs:2881-3010. The CHANGELOG entry at CHANGELOG.md:28 says the earlier job 20261114-160745-8e6x misread 'stored event' as the invocation detail. D191 and the CHANGELOG entry therefore say: the stored check is not what was missing, and the producer never learned what the verifier looks for. The `detail` copy keeps each attempt's invocation record self-contained, so a reader of one attempt need not join to the candidate record. The copy is the same size as the candidate's report and is identical to it for the final attempt. The accepted reading lists it as criterion 4 and as the deliverable producer.rs, so it ships.

rejected.option: Drop the detail copy because the candidate record already holds the report
rejected.why: Criterion 4 and the expected deliverable producer.rs are in the accepted reading. Dropping it would leave a criterion with no demonstration. The cost is one extra copy of a bounded report, and the failing path already stores the same shape.

rejected.option: Describe the detail copy as the fix that makes the pre-verdict check visible
rejected.why: False: the check is already stored and shown (81b1374e). It would repeat the misreading of job 20261114-160745-8e6x.

rejected.why: The failing path's detail is `...; redacted report: <ProducerReport json>`, parsed at run_pin_tests.rs:1799-1800. A different shape for the passing attempt would need a second parser.

decisions.reason: Tests read the criteria_check section as ending in the bare criterion lines (briefs.rs:1653-1664) and assert its wording (1721-1735). A separate section leaves them unchanged. The exact-copy rule (briefs.rs:851-856) stays clean. The brief already tells the producer what the verifier sees (VERIFIER_VISIBILITY, 904-910) and that evidence must be checkable (831-839), but never says which evidence each criterion needs. A criterion list empty (reading.rs:3601 fixture) renders no section, so that test's brief is unchanged.

rejected.option: Append the hint to each bare criterion line
rejected.why: It breaks 'copy the line character for character' and the test at briefs.rs:1658-1663.
The set is budgeted (1043 of 1200), the hint depends on the job's criteria, and a byte change moves the budget line in docs/system-facts.md, which is not a deliverable.

rejected.why: The request prefers information to a refusal rule, and the evidence text is free prose, so a lexical refusal would be wrong in both directions. The send-back loop stays as it is.

decisions.choice: Move `is_athena_check_criterion` into briefs.rs as a `pub fn` and call it from both the hint and send_back.rs. A criterion it matches gets the hint 'Athena's recorded checks show it: begin the evidence with `left to Athena's checks`'.

A generic 'cite the command that ran' hint on the same criterion would give two conflicting instructions. The criteria of this very job (criterion 5) are of that kind. `is_athena_check_criterion` is a pure string function (send_back.rs:67-89). athena-core depends on athena-context (system facts, crate reach), and send_back.rs already imports from `athena_context::briefs` (line 4), so the move is possible. After it, `unmet_criteria` (line 26) and `left_to_athena` (line 45) use the same definition as the hint. Say athena-context cannot reach send_back.rs (round 1 reason)
rejected.why: True of reaching, but the function can move down, and that is the better placement.

decisions.choice: Hint matchers compare whole words and phrases. Lowercase the text, turn every non-alphanumeric character into a space, join the words with single spaces, and test ` {phrase} ` as a substring. Sweep phrases: every mention, every occurrence, every place, every reference, all mentions, all occurrences, all references, no longer appear, no longer appears, no longer used, no longer mentioned, no remaining, zero remaining, no stale, nowhere. Width phrases: line width, line length, rewrap, rewrapped, rewrapping, re wrap, re wrapped, wrapped prose, wrapped lines, wrap width. The plain word 'wrap' is not a phrase.
decisions.reason: Answers finding 3. A substring 'wrap' fires on 'wrapper', which the repository uses (producer.rs:382 'cargo wrapper'). With whole-phrase matching a hyphen ('line-width') and mixed case still match. A wrong match only adds or omits one hint sentence and refuses nothing. Input forms: each sweep phrase, each width phrase, mixed case, hyphenated, trailing punctuation, near-miss 'wrapper', Athena-check criterion, plain content, plain behavior, empty criterion list. The refusal corpus (crates/athena-core/tests/refusal_corpus.rs) holds no case for these forms (a search for 'every mention', 'no longer appear', 'line width', 'rewrap' and 'sweep' found none), and the matcher is not a reading check and refuses no reading, so no case is added. Each form has a unit test in briefs.rs.

rejected.option: Add the phrases to the reading checks (reading/checks.rs)
rejected.why: That would make them refusal rules and require a refused-reading share and corpus cases. The goal is to inform the producer.

decisions.choice: Exit table for the producer loop (producer.rs `producer_loop`, lines 298-720). Only the all-clear exit changes.
decisions.reason:
- All clear, `break Some(report)` at 555: CHANGED. The attempt's `closing.new_invocations.last_mut()` gets `detail = self-check passed; redacted report: <json>`. The next reader is `Reported` (line 714), then `candidate_stage` (candidate.rs:151), which stores the same report in `Candidate.producer_report`, and the closing code, which commits the invocation record.
- Send-back limit reached, `break Some(report)` at 674: unchanged. The detail is `self-check failed` (621); `report_gaps` and `report_kept_in` go to the verifier.
- Send back (676-713): unchanged. The detail is `self-check failed` and the next attempt starts from the send-back brief.
- Timed out (407-418): unchanged. The detail is the deadline text, read by `keep_unfinished_work`.
- Invocation not Success (419-439): unchanged. `producer_stop_reason` reads the detail; an expired login keeps the work via `keep_unfinished_work`; a usage limit is closed as an environment stop.
- Could not run (394-398): unchanged. No record is pushed; `self.failure`.
- Build-slot wait held (444-447): unchanged. Returns Err, the job is held.
- No valid report (448-457): unchanged. `self.failure`.
- Format step stopped (461-464) and records run unreachable (536-539): unchanged. `self.failure`.
- Interrupt: the closing code writes `interrupted_record` (invocation.rs:269). The new detail is set after the invocation returned and was pushed (line 406), so an interrupt is unaffected. The only fallible call is `serde_json::to_string(&report)?`, as at line 624; the report is a plain struct, so it cannot fail.
- The real driver sets no detail on Success (claude.rs:257, `(!ok).then(...)`), so the assignment overwrites nothing; the failing path overwrites in the same way.

rejected.option: Also write a detail at the send-back-limit exit
rejected.why: It already carries `self-check failed` with the report.

Under `[parallel] max_concurrency`, each job has its own `closing`, so the change shares nothing between jobs.

demonstrations.method: Entry point: `producer_brief`, through `producer_brief_with_evidence`. The test renders the brief for a reading with six criteria (sweep, behavior with a command, rewrapped prose, plain content, fmt and clippy, and a 'wrapper' near-miss) and reads the new section. It asserts: a content criterion has 'named file or diff line'; a behavior criterion has 'a command that ran'; the sweep criterion adds 'repo-wide search' and 'zero remaining hits'; the rewrapped-prose criterion adds 'line-width check'; the fmt and clippy criterion gets the `left to Athena's checks` hint and not 'a command that ran'; the 'wrapper' criterion gets no width hint; the section sits before `## criteria_check: copy the line`. Then read the diff of producer.rs: `unmet_criteria`, the `problems` list (producer.rs:557-613) and the send-back text gain no entry, and no `Err`, `Flow::Stop` or hold path is added. The reading checks and refusal corpus are not touched; run `cargo test -p athena-core --test refusal_corpus` to see it pass unchanged (no case maps to these forms, none is added).
demonstrations.observes: One line per criterion with the stated hints, and a diff with no new refusal, send-back or hold condition.

demonstrations.method: New unit test `producer_brief_says_how_the_verifier_checks_each_criterion` in the briefs.rs test module, next to `producer_briefs_list_every_criterion_to_copy_and_ask_for_one_entry_each` (line 1640). It builds `AcceptedReading::new(&reading(), &defaults(), |_| false)`, sets the public `criteria` field (briefs.rs:80) to the six criteria, and calls `producer_brief(&ProducerInputs {..})` as the neighbouring tests do. It takes the text from the heading `## How the verifier checks each criterion` to the next `\n## `, and finds each `Criterion N: ` line. It asserts the hints named in criterion 2, that the section does not repeat any criterion's text, that the heading is before `## criteria_check: copy the line` and after `## Make your evidence checkable`, and that the brief holds none of '0.97', '0.8', 'p10' or 'cost'. A second test, `verifier_check_hint_matches_whole_phrases_only`, calls `verifier_check_hint` directly: 'Every Mention of X is updated' (mixed case) gets the sweep hint; 'line-width' gets the width hint; 'the cargo wrapper is installed' gets neither; 'nowhere else' gets the sweep hint.
demonstrations.observes: Both tests pass with the change.
demonstrations.fails_without: On the base tree the brief has no such section, so `split_once` on the heading panics and the test fails. Removing only the sweep branch fails the 'repo-wide search' assertion. Removing only the behavior branch fails 'a command that ran'. Removing the `is_athena_check_criterion` branch makes the fmt criterion get 'a command that ran' and fails the assertion. Replacing the whole-phrase match with a substring match 'wrap' fails the 'wrapper' case.

demonstrations.method: New test in crates/athena-core/src/run/tests.rs, next to `a_failing_check_is_sent_back_before_the_verifier_and_the_fix_reaches_it` (line 5148). It runs a whole job through `athena.go` with `run_checked_job` (line 5128) on `repo()`, with the check `PASSES` (line 103) and the script `editing(counts, prompts, Vec::new())` (line 3567). The base script's producer (tests.rs:250-262) reports the one criterion met with evidence 'read it' and edits README.md, so the first attempt passes with no send-back. The test loads `Records::load(&athena.git, &athena.head().unwrap())`, as at lines 5191-5198, and takes the producer invocations of the job. It asserts there is exactly one, and that `counts.all()` gives producer 1. It asserts its `detail` starts with 'self-check passed' and contains 'redacted report: '. It parses the JSON after that text into `athena_data::records::ProducerReport` (as run_pin_tests.rs:1799-1800 does) and asserts one `criteria_check` entry for the job's criterion (`CRITERION`, tests.rs:88), with status 'met' and evidence 'read it'. Finally it asserts that this `criteria_check` equals the job's `candidate.producer_report.criteria_check`, the per-attempt copy of the stored report.
demonstrations.observes: The stored detail of a passing producer attempt carries the criterion, its status and its evidence, and matches the candidate's report.
demonstrations.fails_without: On the base tree the passing attempt's `detail` is None, since it is set only on the failing path (producer.rs:621). `unwrap_or_default()` gives an empty string and the 'self-check passed' assertion fails.
demonstrations.seam: Production entry point `Athena::go` into `producer_loop` (producer.rs:298).
